mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Thread titled as a King bearings problem; the reported fault is locating notches positioned incorrectly so the bearing halves sit about .060 out of alignment, close to protruding past the rod. Credible single-builder manufacturing complaint.

mentions.title: King Rod bearings - BMW 3-Series (E90 E92) Forum
mentions.snippet: Mostly a recommendation thread, but members report inconsistency with King rod bearings, including one who found King had packed 0.25 oversize shells in a box labelled STD. Packaging/labelling error rather than a material failure.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings made since 2024 measuring out of spec; poster says the thrust mains slip onto the cap and block groove too easily instead of being an interference fit, raising the risk of spinning the thrust bearing. An experienced builder in the thread says he would not use them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling BMW builders to measure every King bearing before installing. Reported problems include King STDX thrust bearings too narrow for S85 blocks and mis-packed sizes in standard boxes.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King STDX main bearing thrusts over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 blocks, confirmed on two further S85 blocks in the same shop, and the same issue on the S65 set. He advises against King mains for these engines and says a fundamental error like this costs trust in the brand.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Customer received a King SI bi-metal main bearing set containing a shell crushed and twisted in production so it would not seat in the block, and reports bearing shaving debris and oil inside the shrink-wrapped rod bearing pack.
